name: Organismic and Evolutionary Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual undated deadline for entry the following September; no spring admission.

timeline.decisions: Most decisions completed by March (annual, undated).

applicationFee.note: OEB explicitly offers a limited number of waivers to low-income, international or underrepresented applicants who cannot afford the fee. Apply without paying, then contact the program leader named on the admissions page; approval is not guaranteed.

english.toefl: 4 for January 2026 or later tests; 80 for earlier tests
english.note: IELTS Academic and PTE Academic 53 accepted. Scores valid two years at anticipated entrance. No MyBest, IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake, TOEFL Essentials or ITP Plus. Exemptions cover listed citizenships/country degrees, named institutions, qualifying US study, or ECFMG certification; English-medium education alone is not a general exemption.

requirements.note: A faculty sponsor and prior agreement on fit are required; life-science or biological-data training and strong academic background. Central bachelor’s equivalence and minimum undergraduate GPA 2.75 apply. OEB requests official transcripts; central policy accepts unofficial records initially and official records after recommendation. Non-English records need official translations or a NACES course-by-course evaluation.

funding.note: All PhD students normally receive five years of year-round support. Assistantships include tuition/curriculum credits, insurance and most fees, with approximately $750 per semester remaining. Direct admission normally has no rotations; some first-year fellowships require rotations.

sources.label: Admission, sponsor, deadline, waiver and support
